query FlxAppAccess($all: Boolean) {
  flxAppAccess(all: $all) {
    devices {
      id
      name
      platform
      app
      brand
      push
      lastSeen
      lastSeenAgo
      userId
      user
      current
    }
    rows {
      id
      kind
      name
      hint
      userId
      user
      created
      lastUsed
      lastIp
      expires
    }
    canCreateKeys
    canManage
    downloads {
      macos
      windows
      windowsMsi
    }
  }
}
